Name: Cat Valley Interface Recolor for Generic Mod Config Menu
Author: EsterEithern
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Cat Valley Interface Recolor for the gear and keyboard icons in Generic Mod Config Menu. Made this in Ms Paint since I don't find this in other recolors.  [/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]1. Download zip file and extract[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]2. Replace the PNG images in the GMCM mod folder, should be smth like: ...\GenericModConfigMenu\assets [/color]
[color=#d4d4d8](Remember to backup the original images in case u don't want to use them anymore)[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]3. Voila![/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Cat Valley Interface Recolor for the gear and keyboard icons in Generic Mod Config Menu. [/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Generic Mod Config Menu: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098)[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]2. Cat Valley(Interface): https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39379[/color]
